title: REMUS 科學調查平台
summary: 以REMUS近岸科學調查與水域監測為情境，比較密集測線與長續航的取捨；以模擬資料確認流速、定位和量測足跡的差異。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use REMUS coastal science surveys and water monitoring to compare dense lines with endurance, checking distinctions among current, positioning and sensor footprint using simulated data. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 檢查感測模組換裝後的浮力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Check buoyancy after changing sensor modules: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 檢查感測模組換裝後的浮力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Check buoyancy after changing sensor modules and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 檢查感測模組換裝後的浮力：阿基米德浮力取決於排開流體的重量；載具質量與外部排水體積必須使用同一系統邊界。 本步以「排水體積與浮力」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Check buoyancy after changing sensor modules: Archimedean buoyancy is the weight of displaced fluid; vehicle mass and external displaced volume must share a system boundary. Use Displaced volume and buoyancy to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是REMUS 科學調查平台實際規格：海水密度1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²、排水體積V=0.0832 m³。式 F=ρgV，基準結果 836.5968 N。條件：均勻、靜止流體；不含波浪、纜線垂直力與可壓縮性。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of REMUS scientific survey platform: Seawater density 1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², displaced volume V=0.0832 m³. Formula F=ρgV gives 836.5968 N. Conditions: Uniform static fluid; waves, vertical tether forces and compressibility are excluded.
steps.failure: 配重更換後仍沿用舊總質量會錯判淨浮力；先核對零件質量帳，再討論密度誤差。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Reusing the old total mass after changing ballast misidentifies net buoyancy; check the mass ledger before attributing errors to density. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 在常壓透明水槽以塑膠浮體量取排水量，分開記錄乾重及附掛配重；比對浮起方向與模型。 本案例另須檢查「檢查感測模組換裝後的浮力」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Use a plastic float in an unpressurized transparent tank to measure displacement; log dry mass and attached ballast separately and compare motion with the model. Also check that Check buoyancy after changing sensor modules and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：檢查感測模組換裝後的浮力。在近岸測區格網、AUV示意模型、流速與水質假資料完成資料或紙面模型練習。只把排水體積增加10%，核對浮力是否增加10%。 算式區的基準值為836.5968，改變後為920.25648 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Check buoyancy after changing sensor modules. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Coastal survey grid, AUV schematic, synthetic current and water-quality data. Increase only displaced volume by 10% and check a 10% increase in buoyancy. Baseline 836.5968 changes to 920.25648 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較逆流與順流的相對速度。在近岸測區格網、AUV示意模型、流速與水質假資料完成資料或紙面模型練習。只提高相對速度10%，比較平方律的21%增幅。 算式區的基準值為63.857664，改變後為77.267773 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare relative speeds with and against current. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Coastal survey grid, AUV schematic, synthetic current and water-quality data. Raise relative speed alone by 10% and compare the 21% quadratic increase. Baseline 63.857664 changes to 77.267773 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
